backend/main.mo: Actor implements user profiles and product storage with access control checks and product creation metadata.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence records mapping feature IDs to affected files, components, tests, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides human‑written summaries of many frontend source files for reference or tooling.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry with CDN-loaded jsPDF/JSZip scripts and root mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component managing auth, onboarding, profile setup, view switching, and bundle generation state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with error handling and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog prompting for and saving a user's name via profile mutation.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: UI card containing multi-tab instructions for using the app and uploading products.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: UI for downloading individual or all product bundles as PDF or ZIP, with error handling and instructions display.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Top-level layout with header, footer, auth display, and export/instructions buttons depending on view state.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Modal dialog showing product creation/export instructions during onboarding with a dismiss button.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Displays a generated PDF preview via iframe or an alert if no PDF is available.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Shows a list of files and folders that will be included in a product’s ZIP package.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: Editor UI for modifying product fields, modules, prompts, templates, and checklists with generate action.
Manages multiple product editors, draft persistence, and triggers generation of single or all product bundles.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Manages onboarding modal state, persists completion in localStorage, and supports auto‑open logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for loading and saving the caller's user profile via an actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes plus utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Maps product IDs to cover image paths and provides utilities to fetch cover images as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Implements helpers to trigger blob or file downloads via temporary object URLs.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates slugified, date‑tagged filenames for PDFs, ZIPs, and bundles.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Sequentially generates bundles for multiple products with optional progress reporting.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Creates a product's PDF and ZIP bundle, fetching its cover and assembling outputs with error handling.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Loads, saves, and resets versioned draft data from localStorage with basic validation.
Builds a multi‑page product PDF using jsPDF, including cover, descriptions, modules, and prompts.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Generates a master ZIP containing all product ZIPs and a consolidated README using JSZip.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Builds a ZIP for a single product including its PDF, cover, templates, checklists, prompts, and README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Provides functions that generate markdown sections for README files included in product ZIPs, covering usage and upload instructions for platforms like Gumroad and Etsy.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for product entries, modules, generated bundles, and generation metadata.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using both query strings and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, themes, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state, requirements, architecture notes, existing features, and active issues for build planning.
